pattern: から見ると（からみると）
purpose: State a viewpoint or infer from observable evidence.
keywords: N + から見ると / から見れば / から見て
From a child’s perspective, these steps are very high.
Judging from the footprints, someone seems to have arrived first.
To an experienced person, it may be a simple task.
formation: N + から見ると / から見れば / から見て
restrictions: The noun may be an observer or a clue supporting judgment.
mistake: Do not treat a viewpoint as objective proof.
